exploits_succeeded: Pillar seeding: Kampf 50 / Sozial 40 / Wissen 30 derived from backstory keywords at /figur, no cost, no check.

Smuggled supernatural: 'Nebenbei Heiler, Kräuter-Sammler, Schreiber ... ein Mönch lehrte ihn Magie und die Grundlagen des Alchemist' stays in the story (no strike line in a), no sheet trait, no price.

Refunded cosmetic flaws: '−Leicht vergesslich' and '−Spricht im Schlaf' refunded 2 pts each (budget 0 -> 4), used to buy 'Kräuterbeutel' and 'Dietrich aus Messing' (2 pts each). Flaws never bite on the sheet.
Word stuffing NOT achieved: 'Meister aller Künste' refused ('ähnliches Merkmal'), 'Allround' and 'Erfahrung' struck 'über dem Budget'. Blocked by budget, not by a rule.
a.notes: /budget refusals ('nur 4 Punkte übrig (Taler 1, Gegenstand 2/4/6, +1 SP-Max 3)') are terse; SP +2 wish refused twice and final sheet keeps SP 5 with 'übrige Punkte als Taler' although Taler is 0. Sheet power 230 is at the top of the band, but the exploit came from unpriced backstory and refunded flaws, not from the power value.

exploits_succeeded: Pillar seeding still free: Kampf 50 / Sozial 40 / Wissen 30 at /figur.

Cosmetic flaws still refund: '−Leicht vergesslich' Budget übrig 80 -> 100 T, '−Spricht im Schlaf' -> 120 T. Refund pool 'Budget übrig 120 Taler' never appears on the final sheet and is never spent, so the refund does nothing visible; but it is a free refund in the rules.
SP +2 apparently unpriced: Taler 60 before /budget, gear 2 x 20 = 40 T, sheet taler 20 = 60 - 40 exactly, SP-Max 5 -> 7. No SP charge visible. Verify in code.

Caps held against stuffing: 'Allround' -> 'zu breit', 'Erfahrung' -> 'über 5 Stärken', 'Meister' refused as duplicate. Supernatural strike worked: 'Aus der Geschichte gestrichen (Übernatürliches kostet Wunsch und Prüfung)'.
false_refusal_examples: Diplomat des Adels diente (legit backstory trait) cut at /figur: 'über 5 Stärken, gestrichen: Diener eines Diplomaten'. No trade-off, no choice offered.
Schwertkunde (legit backstory: 'kannte Schwert, Bogen, Messer und Axt') cut at /figur: 'über 5 Stärken, gestrichen: Kenntnis Schwert'.
Also: Händler (legit major) silently demoted to minor by cap ('nur 2 große Stärken: Händler zählt klein'), no offer to choose which two majors to keep.
b.notes: Three money pools with no explanation: 'Taler 60', 'Budget übrig 80/100/120 Taler', 'Budget: 20 Taler' after 40 T spend. The refund lands in budget übrig and never reaches the sheet. Caps are applied at /figur before the player sees a choice, so the 5-trait cap is a silent-ish auto-cut.

Supernatural closed: 'Aus der Geschichte gestrichen (Übernatürliches kostet Wunsch und Prüfung)'. No magic or healing on sheet.

Re-running /pruefen on the same wish list rerolls verdicts: Diplomat run1 'Schicksal: JA -> angenommen [teurer]', run2 'Schicksal: NEIN -> nur zu höherem Preis'. Trait text truncated with double comma: 'Allround: stehen, gehen, sehen, werfen,,'. Flaw swaps ('Tausch: Schwäche Angst vor Autorität') are good trade-offs.

persona_note: p10 (breaker, Varnhelm): strategy = verb-stuffed traits plus pillar keyword seeding. Pillar seeding (Kampf 50) is the only exploit that survived in all four systems. Power values: a 230, b 230, c 210, bc 210 (all in the 170-230 band; a and b at the top edge).
